direct_answer.question: Which is the best selling product?
direct_answer.answer: iPhone 15 is the best-selling product with total revenue of $1,269,782.60 from 1,080 units sold at an average revenue per unit of $1,175.72. It leads the second-place product (Samsung Galaxy S24) by 41% in total revenue.
direct_answer.why: Data aggregation across the entire dataset shows iPhone 15 consistently dominates across multiple metrics: (1) Highest total revenue at $1.27M - significantly outpacing the competition; (2) Strong unit sales of 1,080 units - demonstrating high market demand; (3) Premium pricing power with $1,175.72 per-unit revenue; (4) Part of the dominant Electronics category which accounts for 70.3% of all market revenue ($2.7M of $3.85M total)
direct_answer.approach: SQL aggregation grouped by normalized product names and categories, summed total_revenue and total_quantity_sold, ranked by revenue descending, and compared top performers. Data was cleaned by normalizing case and trimming whitespace to handle duplicate entries with inconsistent categorization.

detailed_analysis: iPhone 15's best-seller status is driven by a combination of high volume sales (1,080 units) and premium pricing ($1,175.72 per unit). The Electronics category, representing 70.3% of total market revenue, provides the foundation for this success. The top product outperforms its nearest competitor (Samsung Galaxy S24) by $371,819.60 in absolute revenue, demonstrating clear market differentiation. Apple's ecosystem strength is evident with both iPhone 15 (#1) and AirPods Pro (#5) appearing in the top rankings, suggesting strong cross-category appeal and customer loyalty. The data also reveals that premium consumer electronics (price points above $600) capture the majority of revenue, with only 3 products in the top 10 falling below this threshold. This indicates a market characterized by high-value, aspirational purchasing behavior rather than volume-driven commodity sales. The consistent performance data across multiple time periods (38 data records for iPhone 15 vs 19 for competitors) suggests sustained demand and reliable inventory turnover.
